Subject: Data protection annex and SCC wording for cloud SaaS vendors

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement has asked us to collect a few items before we can move your platform forward for the district pilot: a signed data protection annex (we have a preferred annex for public entities), confirmation you can reference SCCs (or provide equivalent language), and either a SOC 2 Type II report or a redacted SOC scope. The security office also wants a short DPIA summary that maps your data flows for student data.

Can you provide your standard DPA + any addendum you offer for public-sector customers, and point us to the SCC clause text you accept? If you can also attach the SOC 2 and a one-page DPIA summary, that would be ideal.

We need this for our December 9 procurement committee deadline.

Thanks,

Thanks Rishi — these look helpful. A couple quick follow-ups from our security team:
1) On subprocessors: can you confirm whether any subprocessors will see student PII in cleartext, and which data centers host the HSM/KMS keys?
2) For the DPIA spreadsheet, can you add a column indicating whether processing is necessary for public-interest functions (education delivery) and a short justification?

Also procurement asked if you would be open to our public-sector DPA annex with a single redline: a requirement for 7-year records retention for audit purposes for financial and procurement metadata. Is that something Redwood can commit to? If not, can you propose an alternative retention period and an evidence path for audits?

Appreciate the quick turnaround here.

—Jeff

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Jeffrey Kahn <jeffrey.kahn@pcccd.edu>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-28T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Data protection annex and SCC wording for cloud SaaS vendors

Jeff — quick status update after internal review:
- Subprocessors & PII: Rishi confirms that no subprocessors store student PII in cleartext beyond encrypted application storage; only our managed DBs in the US-west region store PII and access is restricted. I asked Karthik to add a short paragraph to the DPIA that clarifies 'public-interest' processing for education delivery.
- KMS/HSM: Keys are managed in a KMS with separate control plane; primary key material for production tenant encryption is in AWS KMS (us-west-2) with strict IAM roles. We will provide the high-level architecture diagram via the Drive link.
- 7-year retention: Our standard retention for audit metadata is 3 years. For public-sector contracts we can make a contract-level exception to 7 years for financial/procurement metadata (logs, invoices, billing reconciliation) provided we include controls to restrict access and a cost-based fee to retain long-term snapshots. Laura, can you review and prepare a proposed clause that offers the 7-year retention only for narrowly-scoped financial metadata?

We plan to send a combined package (DPA with the narrowly-scoped retention clause, SCC text, SOC 2, DPIA updated) by EOD today so you can circulate to the committee.

Vanessa
